description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Order made to impose a Special Commodity Levy on Potatoes, B'Onions, etc. valid for a period of 03 months commencing from 01.07.2016
reasoning: This gazette content imposes a Special Commodity Levy on specific goods (potatoes, onions, maize, sorghum) under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It constitutes a regulatory measure establishing tax rates and compliance requirements, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) rather than government personnel/structure categories. The mention of the Acting Minister serves only to establish the authority behind the order, not to announce a personnel change or describe ministerial portfolios.
